title: Chuy’s Hatch Green Chile Sauce
steps: Dissolve beef base in 1 qt water in a large saucepot. Heat over medium-high.
Add pepper, garlic salt, salt and onion. Simmer about 12 minutes, until onion softens.
Add roasted green chiles and return to a simmer.
Whisk cornstarch with ½ cup water until smooth. Slowly stir into the simmering sauce, then simmer 8–10 minutes more, stirring occasionally, until the sauce gains body.
